qualifier: RNA editing (C-to-U and A-to-I) plus antiviral restriction
name: APOBEC/ADAR deaminase RNA editing and antiviral restriction
rationale: All members concern cytidine or adenosine deamination by APOBEC or ADAR enzymes, in nucleic-acid editing or in restricting viral and foreign nucleic acids; the ADAR adenosine-to-inosine editing members separate it from the APOBEC3G/HIV, DNA-demethylation and antibody-diversification confusables.

name: Taste and smell chemosensory perception
rationale: Members are taste modalities (sweet, bitter, umami, sour, salty), olfactory receptors and odorant/pheromone responses, plus the TRP, TALK and acid-sensing channels used in chemosensation; confusables cover pain/thermosensation, CFTR epithelial transport, nose development and other K2P channels.

core: Growth factor receptor tyrosine signaling to RAS and PI3K
qualifier: MET/HGF-centred, with EPO, IGF1R/IRS and ALK/LTK inputs
name: MET/HGF-centred growth factor receptor signaling to RAS and PI3K
rationale: Members are phosphotyrosine receptor signaling to SOS/RAS, PI3K/AKT, PLCG and STAT3, dominated by MET/HGF events with EPO, IGF1R/IRS and ALK/LTK inputs; the MET/HGF set separates it from ERBB, AKT and cytokine-receptor confusables.

core: DNA base damage and mismatch repair
qualifier: base excision, mismatch and alkylation reversal, not NER or translesion synthesis
name: Base excision, mismatch and alkylation-reversal DNA repair
rationale: Members cover glycosylase-initiated base excision repair and its defects, mismatch repair and its defects, direct alkylation reversal, interstrand cross-link repair and TDG-mediated demethylation; confusables are nucleotide excision repair, translesion synthesis and antibody hypermutation.

name: Glycosaminoglycan chain biosynthesis and its congenital defects
rationale: Members are chondroitin, dermatan, heparan and keratan sulfate chain and linkage-region synthesis plus the inherited glycosyltransferase/sulfotransferase defects in them; confusables center on sulfate/nucleotide-sugar transporter defects, Notch O-glycosylation and dystroglycan glycosylation.

name: Rhesus glycoprotein ammonium and CO2 transport
rationale: Members concern Rh-family (RHAG) proteins, Rh blood group synthesis and ammonium/CO2 membrane transport; confusables are erythrocyte O2/CO2 exchange and peptide transporters, lacking the Rhesus ammonium channel.

name: Integrin substrate adhesion and spreading via MET-FAK/tensin
rationale: Members are integrin and syndecan cell-matrix attachment, spreading, migration and stress fibers; the MET-PTK2 and MET-tensin members are what all confusables (ROCK/PAK cytoskeleton, ECM/EMT, invadopodia) lack.

qualifier: Fanconi anemia cross-link repair and monoubiquitination cycle
name: Fanconi anemia cross-link repair and monoubiquitination in genome stability
rationale: Members combine interstrand cross-link repair, protein monoubiquitination/deubiquitination, recombination-intermediate resolution and checkpoint/p53 repair-gene control; the Fanconi pathway monoubiquitination cycle separates it from homologous recombination and telomere/fork confusables.

qualifier: leukotrienes plus cytochrome P450 HETE/EET branches
name: Leukotriene and cytochrome P450 HETE/EET eicosanoid metabolism
rationale: All members are eicosanoid synthesis, transport or catabolism, combining cysteinyl/B4 leukotrienes with P450 omega-hydroxylase and epoxygenase products; confusables lack the P450 branches (lipoxin-focused) or the cysteinyl leukotriene arm (12-LOX/hepoxilin).

qualifier: BCL-2 family, cytochrome c, apoptosome, with p53 transcriptional induction
name: p53-driven mitochondrial apoptosis via BCL-2 family and apoptosome
rationale: Members are BH3-only/BAX/BAK activation, outer-membrane permeabilization, cytochrome c and SMAC release, apoptosome caspase activation and p53 transcription of death genes; p53-signaling confusables lack the mitochondrial machinery and extrinsic/necroptosis confusables lack the p53 transcription arm.

name: Glycolysis/gluconeogenesis with GLUT1 and hexokinase deficiencies
rationale: All members concern the glucose uptake-glycolysis-gluconeogenesis axis including GLUT1 and HK1 defects; confusables are glycogen, fructose, galactose and pentose metabolism.

core: Host-genome interplay with foreign and rearranged DNA
qualifier: retroviral replication, host restriction and immunoglobulin gene diversification
name: Retroviral replication, host restriction and immunoglobulin gene diversification
rationale: Members span the HIV/retroviral DNA life cycle and integration, APOBEC and KRAB-ZFP/HUSH restriction of viruses and retroelements, and V(D)J, hypermutation and class switching of immunoglobulin genes; confusables are RNA-virus replication and translation (SARS-CoV, RSV, influenza) and ADAR editing.

name: CC chemokine production for monocyte/macrophage recruitment
rationale: Members regulate CCL2, CCL3 and CCL5 production, STAT6-induced chemokines and macrophage chemotaxis; confusables are cGAS-STING dendritic cytokines and formyl-peptide neutrophil recruitment.

name: Cobalamin uptake and transport and their inherited defects
rationale: Members are dietary cobalamin uptake, plasma transport and lysosomal export and the CBLIF, TCN2 and ABCD4 defects; confusables are intracellular cobalamin metabolism and methylmalonic acidemia defects.

name: Neutrophil degranulation and myeloid cell-mediated killing
rationale: Members are neutrophil degranulation, neutrophil cytotoxicity and myeloid immune activation; confusables emphasize complement/monocyte inflammation or respiratory burst and antibacterial killing.

name: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are glutamate/glutamine synthesis and breakdown, aspartate/asparagine metabolism and nitrogen utilization; aspartate and citrulline members separate it from alanine/gluconeogenesis, TCA/malate-aspartate shuttle and proline/glycine confusables.

core: Coenzyme A and NAD(P) cofactor metabolism
name: CoA and NADP cofactor synthesis with peroxisomal acyl-CoA metabolism
rationale: Members are pantothenate-CoA and NADP+ synthesis, NAD transport, malonyl/succinyl/medium-chain acyl-CoA metabolism and peroxisome fission/processing; confusables are fatty acid oxidation, TCA/PDH and carnitine/choline catabolism without cofactor synthesis.

qualifier: between Golgi, endosomes, lysosomes and plasma membrane
name: Post-Golgi trafficking among Golgi, endosomes, lysosomes and plasma membrane
rationale: Members are Golgi-to-endosome/lysosome sorting, endosome-to-Golgi retrieval, receptor recycling and Golgi retention; confusables center on COPI/ER-Golgi traffic, Golgi organization and Rab regulation.

name: Microautophagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy and aggrephagy
rationale: Members are microautophagy (endosomal, nuclear), chaperone-mediated autophagy, aggrephagy, ATG8 delipidation and nitrogen-starvation response; confusables are pexophagy/mitophagy and aggresome/misfolded-protein quality control.

qualifier: noncanonical ERK5 and MAPK6/4 branches with serine phosphorylation control
name: Noncanonical ERK5 and MAPK6/4 signaling with serine phosphorylation control
rationale: Members are ERK5 and atypical MAPK6/MAPK4 cascades, RAS-MAPK signaling, Ras-GAP tuning and regulation of serine phosphorylation; confusables center on ERK1/2 RAF mutant and feedback inactivation or neurotrophin-driven activation.

qualifier: centriole duplication, spindle positioning and ciliogenesis
name: Centrosome control of spindle positioning, centriole duplication and cilia
rationale: Members are MTOC microtubule nucleation/anchoring, centriole duplication and cohesion, spindle orientation and asymmetric division, and cilium assembly/disassembly; confusables are mitotic centrosome maturation (AURKA, NuMA) and tubulin modification.

name: Two-pore, ATP-sensitive and Ca2+-activated potassium channels in excitability
rationale: Members are K2P (TWIK, TREK, TASK, THIK, TRESK), KATP (ABCC8/9 defects) and Ca2+-activated K+ channels regulating resting potential and excitability; confusables are Na+/K+ transport, Kir/voltage-gated channels and action-potential propagation.

qualifier: cadherin, PTEN and PD-L1 promoters, PAX3 targets, ALK-STAT3
name: Transcriptional control of cadherins, PTEN, PD-L1 and PAX3 targets
rationale: Members are promoter-level transcriptional regulation, mostly repression, of CDH1/CDH11, PTEN, PD-L1 and TGFBR3, PAX3 targets and ALK-STAT3 nuclear events; confusables are RUNX3, FOXO and BMP/TGF-beta transcription programs.

name: Glycosphingolipid biosynthesis and glycolipid transfer
rationale: Members are ganglioside/galactosylceramide synthesis and glycolipid and ceramide-1-phosphate transport; confusables are GPI anchor synthesis, phospholipid transfer and lysosomal glycosphingolipid catabolism.

name: Mitochondrial protein processing and proteolytic degradation
rationale: All three members concern proteolytic processing and degradation of mitochondrial proteins; confusables cover mitochondrial import, cristae and calcium uptake or ER quality control.
